title: Fashion
summary: A fashion-film look where the footage carries everything: one short white word at a time in clean sans capitals (heavy and wide, or tall and condensed), revealed letter by letter out of a soft blur; the shot shown as a clean card over a blurred, enlarged copy of itself or split into vertical panels; soft zoom-blur, whip and colour-streak cuts; a gentle film grade; hairline rules and tiny credits-style labels. Lots of air, one accent, almost no ornament. For fast edits it adds operated mock-UI cards, kinetic type, project-fed charts and harder cuts in the same restrained look.
